title: Dystopian Rift: The Junker's Ultimate Aftereffect
summary: In a draconic dystopia, a plucky worker traces vanishing lines, while imperial guards patrol and citizens offer muted hallelujahs. At the edge of a great rift, she observes monks referencing ancient texts, a titan ravaged by dystrophy emitting a prickle of energy, threatening a breakout from infancy. In a tense close-up, she operates a makeshift printer, attempting to enjoin a panicky minority of ichthyoid beings as intrigue fills the air. The ultimate aftereffect: she stands victorious on a waymark, overseeing lower icefields and skyjack obelisks, as a new landscape flourishes, free from offence.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a draconic dystopia, a plucky worker traces the vanishing lines of a defunct disco sign, while imperial guards patrol and citizens offer muted hallelujahs.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a draconic dystopia under a bruised sunset. Junker buildings, jackhammered into submission, rise like jagged teeth. A plucky worker, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen from behind, tracing the vanishing lines of a defunct disco sign. Imperial guards in viral kimonos patrol, their jingled armor clanking, while nappy citizens feed on glimmering nuggets, offering muted hallelujahs to vanquished hopes. The air looks heavy with a strange, oppressive energy.

scenes.sentence: At the edge of a great rift, the worker observes monks referencing ancient texts while a titan, ravaged by dystrophy, emits a prickle of energy, threatening a breakout from infancy.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot, cool and desaturated, focusing on the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls. She stands at the edge of a great rift, a cavern of shimmering energy, observing monks in flannel robes who referenced ancient texts. A titan of the old world, ravaged by dystrophy and lycanthropy, emits a prickle of energy, its flyaway hair almost touching the ceiling of the cavern. The burden of this union is palpable, hinting at a breakout from infancy, a crybaby player facing a new challenge in these hidden rooms, desperately salving the peepee-sized crack in reality.

scenes.sentence: In a tense close-up, the worker operates a makeshift printer, attempting to enjoin a panicky minority of ichthyoid beings as intrigue fills the air.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up, harsh rim lighting, showing the teenager's hands, the cracked jade compass on a leather cord glowing faintly as she operates a makeshift printer, its valves whirring. Her lanky frame is just out of shot, but the oil-stained mechanic coveralls are visible. Beside her, a mayfly flits near a playpen filled with powdery, unidentifiable material. She is offhand, yet movingly determined, trying to enjoin a minority of ichthyoid beings who, like a panicky gemsbok, approve only of the swanky Viking kayaked down a stream of ketchup. Intrigue hangs heavy in the air, a white light reflects in her focused eyes.

scenes.sentence: The ultimate aftereffect: the worker stands victorious on a waymark, overseeing lower icefields and skyjack obelisks, as a new landscape flourishes.
scenes.prompt: Overhead wide shot, soft diffused light, revealing an ultimate aftereffect. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now stands victorious on a waymark overlooking vast, lower icefields. Skyjack obelisks, once menacing, now stand as inert monuments. Vapory clouds drift over a field of bravely blooming cactus, symbolizing the flyback of nature. Flyboys are seen in the distance, their viewpoints forever altered. No longer paunchy, the underground is now unbaked, free from offence, a new landscape forged by her brave act.
